hero.headline: Uninterrupted Power for High-Density AI
hero.subheadline: Directly integrated with a captive power source, our facility eliminates grid instability and ensures a consistent 1MW flow to your hardware.

sections.title: Industrial-Grade Power Architecture
sections.body: The lifeblood of Kenya AI Compute is our proprietary power distribution network. Unlike traditional facilities that rely on aging national grids, we are connected via a dedicated, zero-distance high-voltage link to our captive hybrid power plant. This eliminates the risk of regional blackouts and provides a clean, stable sine wave required for the most sensitive H100 and A100 GPU clusters. Inside each modular unit, we deploy a sophisticated N+1 UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) architecture using high-density lithium-ion battery arrays. These systems act as a critical buffer, providing instantaneous failover while our secondary gas and diesel generation units synchronize. Every rack is serviced by redundant A+B power feeds, ensuring that even during scheduled maintenance of our primary generators, your computational tasks remain active and profitable. sections.title: Electrical Specifications
items: Source: Direct captive hybrid generation (Solar + Gas) with industrial backup.
Distribution: Dual-path A+B power feeds to every server cabinet.
UPS System: N+1 modular lithium-ion UPS with >96% efficiency.
Monitoring: Per-outlet energy tracking via intelligent PDU units.
Surge Protection: Multi-stage TVSS protection throughout the electrical chain.
